input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP package meets our preferred position. § 14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data, Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a processing right limited to delivering the Services. § 14.2 vests ownership of Deliverables in Customer with an express present assignment from Vendor plus personnel assignments and further-assurances. § 14.3 leaves Vendor with only its pre-existing Vendor Technology and routes embedded Vendor Technology to the § 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works for Customer's business (including Affiliates and contractors). § 14.4 expressly negates joint ownership absent a signed instrument and keeps feedback voluntary with Customer retaining unrestricted use. § 15.1 further bars model training on Customer Data without our consent. Minor points noted but not deviations: Deliverable ownership is tied to payment of Fees and to work identified in an Order Form, and the Customer Data definition carves out anonymized operational telemetry that cannot be linked back to us — neither assigns our IP or data to Vendor.
